provenance: User-supplied real files initially presented as one VASP set; inspection established that they are from different structures or calculation states.
referenceElectronNote: These are assumed standard valence-electron counts used as provisional Bader references: Cu 11 (3d10 4s1), S 6, O 6, F 7, N 5, C 4, and H 1. They must be verified against POTCAR ZVAL values before publication. They are often called core-electron inputs in the interface, but scientifically they are the neutral-reference/valence electron counts when ACF.dat was generated from valence density.
diagnostic: ACF.dat contains 156 atoms but CONTCAR contains 152 atoms. Coordinates also do not align, so charge-to-element mapping is unsafe.
scientificUse: Negative robustness benchmark only; do not calculate or report element-resolved Bader charges from this pair.
